prompt: Operator: batched matmul C[b]=A[b]@B[b] (float16 inputs, float32 cube accumulator, float16 output via cast on store). Input shapes: A [B,M,K]=[16,256,256], B [B,K,N]=[16,256,256]. Output: [B,M,N]=[16,256,256]. Axis: -1 (K, contracted, per batch). Layout: flatten [B,M,K]->[B*M,K], [B,K,N]->[B*K,N], [B,M,N]->[B*M,N] on the host so each batch is a contiguous row-block. Tiling: batch_per_core -- launch CORE_NUM=B cube cores, bi=asc2.block_idx() handles batch bi (rows bi*M of A/C, bi*K of B). Stage the whole per-batch A[M,K] and B[K,N] into asc2.TileLocation.L1 once, then for each M tile copy [M_TILE,K]->L0A and for each N tile copy [K,N_TILE]->L0B, compute `a_i @ b_j`, `.to(asc2.float16)`, asc2.store. All of M,K,N,M_TILE,N_TILE must be multiples of 16; keep each L0 tile <= 64 KiB (M_TILE=128, full K=256 -> A tile 64 KiB). Accumulator: float32 (cube). Tolerance: atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-2 vs torch.bmm(a.float(), b.float()).to(torch.float16). Host inputs MUST be torch.Tensor (numpy is silently zeroed on the C310 cube path). Platform: Ascend950PR_9599. Build/run: python3.11 kernel.py -r Model -v Ascend950PR_9599.
